meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI. Native-code trust gate with exact version pins required.

scientific_integrity.detail: No data fabrication; operates on real genomic intervals with proper coordinate system documentation

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for genomic interval operations; clear boundaries for assembly, coordinate systems, and strand handling

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established BED format standards and genomic interval algebra; proper coordinate system (0-based, half-open)

code_usability.detail: Complete working examples with native-code trust gate and 6 bundled deterministic validation CLIs

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive genomic interval operations with Python, Rust, and CLI interfaces; excellent 6-reference progressive disclosure; minor: CLI examples could be more explicit for 0.9.0 surface

reliability.note: Perfect: explicit version pinning (Python 0.9.2, Rust 0.9.0), SHA-256 checksums, lockfile guidance, and stale-pattern migration warnings

performance_context.note: Well-structured 283-line SKILL.md with 6 reference files; clear sections; minor: density could be reduced with more reference delegation

agent_usability.note: Strong trigger description with specific genomic operations; clear when-to-use patterns; minor: could benefit from explicit 'When NOT to Use' section

human_usability.note: Excellent installation with uv, SHA-256 verification, native-code trust gate, and exact version pins; comprehensive safety protocols

security.note: Perfect: native-code trust gate, network/cache controls, sensitive metadata guidance, patient split-leakage warnings, and bundled network-free validators

maintainability.note: Good structure with version 1.2, license notes, compatibility; migration traps documented; minor: no explicit changelog reference

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with genomic data contract; excellent validation CLIs; good progressive disclosure; minor: tokenizer/refget workflows could be more explicit about approval gates

key_strengths: Exceptional security posture with native-code trust gate, SHA-256 verification, network/cache controls, and patient split-leakage prevention
Perfect reliability with exact version pinning (Python 0.9.2, Rust 0.9.0), lockfile guidance, and comprehensive stale-pattern migration warnings
Comprehensive genomic data contract with assembly, coordinate system, contig, sorting, strand, and adjacency rules clearly documented
Six bundled deterministic, network-free validation CLIs (bed_validator, execution_plan, tokenizer_manifest, refget_digest_plan, coverage_preflight, artifact_inspector)
Excellent progressive disclosure with 6 focused reference files covering Python API, overlap, coverage, tokenizers, refget, and CLI
